findings.summary: Core launch layout fails at phone and tablet widths
evidence: 390x844 Chromium emulation and real Firefox clip the launch-sequence headline
768x1024 reports 98px horizontal overflow
real Chrome 150 and Firefox 153 reproduce clipped nav/status content at 768x1024
findings.remediation: Add phone/tablet layout constraints and automated no-overflow assertions.

findings.summary: Axe confirms 28 color-contrast failures across public routes
evidence: home mission eyebrow 3.12:1 where 4.5:1 is required
home status eyebrow 1.39:1 where 4.5:1 is required
network pulse text 4.04:1 where 4.5:1 is required
gradient-backed nodes remain incomplete and require manual review
findings.remediation: Replace failing color pairs with tested semantic tokens and manually review gradient-backed content.

findings.summary: Activation dialog and tabs have an incomplete keyboard and ARIA contract
evidence: focus returns to BODY after Escape close
background main/nav are not inert or aria-hidden
ArrowLeft does not change the selected tab
tabs omit roving tabindex, aria-controls, and tabpanel relationships
findings.remediation: Restore opener focus, isolate modal siblings, and implement the complete tabs pattern.

findings.summary: Decorative verify orbit creates 288px of desktop document overflow
evidence: 1440x900 viewport: clientWidth 1425, scrollWidth 1713
.verify-orbit extends to x=1713
findings.remediation: Contain or clip the decorative orbit and assert zero route-root overflow.

findings.summary: Skip focus, heading order, generic ARIA labels, and landmarks need repair
evidence: skip activation leaves focus on the link instead of main
launch sequence H2 precedes page H1
axe reports aria-prohibited-attr incomplete on generic div labels
two home nodes sit outside landmarks
findings.remediation: Move focus to main, repair the heading outline, use semantic roles, and contain content in landmarks.

findings.summary: Network lookup completion and errors are not programmatically announced
evidence: malformed input renders an invalid-address message
no result-specific alert or live region is present
focus moves to BODY after submission
valid public address lookup otherwise succeeds
findings.remediation: Preserve focus and announce validation/result state through alert/live semantics.

findings.summary: LaunchPage emits a React unique-key console error
evidence: title.split lines are mapped to anonymous fragments
findings.remediation: Give each fragment a stable key or remove the fragment list.

findings.summary: Two home images omit intrinsic dimensions
evidence: /images/outer-comms-v1.webp
/images/ascent-ritual-v1.webp
findings.remediation: Publish matching intrinsic dimensions or aspect-ratio metadata.

findings.summary: iOS Safari, physical Android, Linux graphical browsers, and screen readers were unavailable
evidence: iPhone and Android results are viewport emulation only
Ubuntu evidence is build/rendered-HTML CI, not graphical browser execution
findings.remediation: Run and publish the same matrix in a real browser/device accessibility lab.
